snohomish-community-church-snohomish-wa.assessment: Listed in The Gospel Coalition Church Directory — TGC's open self-listing of gospel-believing churches, sponsored by Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary. Inclusion does NOT imply TGC vetting against the Foundation Documents (Confessional Statement + Theological Vision for Ministry); 52% of listings have no formal network affiliation, and the rest carry Acts 29 / SEND / Harbor / Converge / Redeemer-CTC tags. Treat TGC Directory presence as a discoverability signal, not a doctrinal endorsement — confirm complementarianism + inerrancy independently before publishing.
snohomish-community-church-snohomish-wa.gender_detail: Verify on church website — TGC Directory does NOT require complementarian polity for listing.

snoqualmie-valley-bible-church-carnation.assessment: Listed in the 9Marks Church-Search directory. 9Marks publishes the directory as a discoverability tool for Reformed Baptist-leaning, congregationalist, expositional churches that self-identify with the 9 Marks of a Healthy Church (Mark Dever). NOTE: Inclusion is user-submitted via 9marks.org and is NOT individually vetted by 9Marks editorial staff. Treat directory presence as a self-attested signal of alignment with the 9 Marks values; confirm independently before publishing.
snoqualmie-valley-bible-church-carnation.gender_detail: Verify on church website — 9Marks Church-Search listings self-attest to complementarian polity but the directory does not enforce.

snowy-range-efca-laramie-wy.gender_detail: Male senior pastor (Mark Vaporis). EFCA polity. Children's ministry led by female Director (Shannon Brown) — ministry-role staff, not eldership.

snyder-memorial-baptist-church-fayettevi.assessment: SBC church in Fayetteville, North Carolina. Added to directory for evaluation. Southern Baptist Convention affiliation provides denominational accountability through the Baptist Faith & Message 2000.

score_notes.christology: 'Jesus Christ is the Son of God and the only means of salvation' per beliefs page — orthodox but vaguely stated; creeds not named.
score_notes.scripture: 'The Bible is the inspired and authoritative Word of God' — authoritative language but not explicit inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: Beliefs page explicitly affirms 'the role of both' women and men in ministry, citing priesthood of all believers. Staff includes Jen Rabon (Director of Children & Family Ministries) and Susie Reeder (Minister of Missions).
score_notes.leadership: Senior Pastor Blake Benge; ministry staff includes women with 'Minister' titles.
score_notes.soteriology: 'Personal faith in Jesus Christ' for salvation per beliefs — generic evangelical language.
score_notes.cultural: Refugee/immigrant advocacy via CBFNC partnership; not overtly progressive but trajectory toward social-justice framing.
score_notes.preaching: Two services (8:40am Contemporary, 11am Traditional); preaching style not detailed.
score_notes.mission: Partners with CBFNC on local ministries (Welcome House Fayetteville for refugees/immigrants).
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Not stated on available sources — verify in person.
score_notes.denominational: Moderate Baptist — SBC-adjacent but with significant CBFNC partnership. Egalitarian gender policy.

snyder-memorial-baptist-church-fayettevi.gender_detail: Egalitarian per beliefs statement; women hold 'Minister' roles (Susie Reeder, Minister of Missions)
